item.title: Wolverine.HTTP Learns the QUERY Verb
item.description: I’m mostly out this week on a family vacation and this is the most ambitious blog post I’m going to be up to until I’m back:) Wolverine.HTTP (in 6.17.0 last week) added support for the HTTP QUERY method (RFC 10008) through a single new [WolverineQuery] attribute.
